extName.message: Ad Interceptor — Ad Blocker & Pop-up Blocker
extName.description: Chrome Web Store item title. Max 75 chars. Keep 'Ad Interceptor' as the brand and translate only the descriptor after the dash — store search is per-locale and this field carries the most weight. Never use the 'AdBlock' prefix (trademarked).
